lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Station. Home port for nine hundred people.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: No beacon, no traffic control, no life signs I can read from here. The ring's... cold.

lines.speaker: meridian
lines.text: —this is Controller Abara, Meridian— they came out of the cells in the walls— evacuating to the lower ring— if anyone hears this, don't dock. Don't—

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Nothing. No answer. I'm sorry, Captain.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: One small mercy: we came in behind the rock cluster. Whatever did this hasn't seen us yet.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Then we use it. Everyone stays behind the rocks until we know what we're facing.
